email_subject: Application - Digital Marketing Intern at Fermedics
email_body:
Dear Fermedics team,

I'm applying for the Digital Marketing Intern role. Your focus on fermented botanical ingredients and the B2B supplement market caught my attention—especially the challenge of building a digital strategy from the ground up.

My background sits at the intersection of SEO, content, and web. I've built and optimized sites for traditional and AI search, including structured data and llms.txt to help LLMs like Claude and ChatGPT find them. I use Semrush and Ahrefs daily, write SEO content, and manage WordPress sites. I'm also comfortable with Canva and have launched social content for B2B clients.

I'm a digital native, curious about AI search, and eager to own projects. I'd love to help Fermedics grow its Instagram presence and get influencers on board.

Looking forward to discussing how I can contribute.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Fermedics team,

I'm writing to apply for the Digital Marketing Intern position. What draws me to Fermedics is the combination of a fast-growing scale-up, the fermentation trend, and the B2B supplement market—a space where clear, science-backed communication can make a real difference. Your mission to build a digital marketing strategy from the basics you already have is exactly the kind of hands-on challenge I enjoy.

My experience sits where SEO, content, and web meet. As a freelancer and junior digital marketer, I've built and optimized websites for both traditional and AI-powered search. For mirook.com, I implemented JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file, and ran technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably improved search health. I use Semrush and Ahrefs daily for keyword research and gap analysis, and I've written and published SEO blog content for client sites in WordPress. I'm also comfortable with Canva for visuals and have managed social media integration for B2B clients.

What I bring to Fermedics is a digital-native mindset: I know social media, content, and SEO, and I'm genuinely curious about how AI search is changing discovery. I'm creative, hands-on, and independent—I like to own projects from plan to execution. I'm particularly excited about launching and growing your Instagram account and getting relevant influencers on board, as well as mapping out the sales funnel and setting up campaigns.

I'm a strong writer in English (fluent) and have a keen interest in health, food, and science. I'd love to help Fermedics showcase its finished products and build a content plan that drives conversions.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
• SEO & GEO expertise: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical audits, structured data, and AI search visibility (llms.txt, entity optimization) – directly applicable to Semrush-driven SEO/GEO improvements.
• Content & CMS: SEO blog writing, website content management in WordPress (Elementor, Rank Math), and Canva for visuals – ready to create social posts, blog posts, mailings, and website copy.
• AI & automation: daily use of LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) for research and content, prompt engineering, and Python automation – aligns with curiosity about AI search and GEO.
• Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs – supports mapping the sales funnel and setting up campaigns.
• Social media & B2B experience: managed social media integration for B2B clients and created content for e-commerce – prepared to launch and grow Instagram and LinkedIn presence.
